title: Obstacles: cacti spawn ahead at random gaps, scroll left at state.speed and are dropped off-screen; touching one ends the run; intent.restart on a finished run starts a fresh one
body:
## Context

t1 (jump) is on `main`: the dino jumps and lands. `state.obstacles` is an empty array nothing fills, `state.over` is never set to true, and the intent field `restart` is read by nobody in the rules. Everything around the rule already exists: the renderer draws every `{ x, y, w, h }` in `state.obstacles`, the policy in `scripts/play.mjs` asks for a jump when the nearest obstacle is within 60 px, and the page sends `intent.restart` when Space/Enter is pressed on a finished run. The page also recreates the game by itself on restart (`index.html`, the `if (intent.restart && state.over)` line); this ticket moves that decision into the rules, so there is one source of truth, and deletes the page's own copy of it.

## Scope

1. `src/tuning.js` (additive keys under `TUNING`): `obstacle: { w, hMin, hMax }` (px), `spawn: { grace, gapMin, gapMax }` (px of distance: no obstacle before `grace`; consecutive obstacles are separated by a gap drawn in `[gapMin, gapMax]`). Choose numbers a t1 jump can clear at `speed` 4 — a jump lasts roughly 30–40 ticks, i.e. 120–160 px of ground — and keep `gapMin` comfortably above one jump's length.
2. `src/game.js`:
   - **Spawn.** A new state field `nextSpawnAt` (px of distance) starts at `spawn.grace`. On a tick where `state.distance >= state.nextSpawnAt`, push `{ x: TUNING.width, y: TUNING.groundY - h, w: obstacle.w, h }` with `h` drawn from `rand(state)` in `[hMin, hMax]` (integer), and set `nextSpawnAt = state.distance + gap`, `gap` drawn from `rand(state)` in `[gapMin, gapMax]`. ALL randomness through `rand(state)`.
   - **Scroll.** Every obstacle moves `x -= state.speed` each tick; an obstacle with `x + w < 0` is removed on that tick.
   - **Collision.** After moving, if the dino's box overlaps any obstacle's box (AABB: `a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y`), set `state.over = true`. Once over, `step()` changes nothing (existing early return), except:
   - **Restart.** `step(state, { restart: true })` on a run that is over resets the run IN PLACE (same object): tick 0, distance 0, no obstacles, dino on the ground, `over` false, `nextSpawnAt` back to `grace`, and a fresh `rng` derived from the old one (e.g. `Math.floor(rand(state) * 2 ** 32)`), so consecutive runs differ but the whole sequence still replays from the first seed. `restart` on a run that is NOT over does nothing. Keep the reset in one helper so t3 can preserve the fields it adds (`best`).
3. `index.html`: remove the page's own `state = createGame(...)` on restart; the page keeps sending `intent.restart` and `step()` does the rest.
4. Tests (`tests/obstacles.test.mjs`): the criteria below. Existing tests stay green.
5. Docs, in the same commit as the rule: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (`obstacles` items, `nextSpawnAt`, restart semantics), `docs/TICKETS.md` (t2 to Done), `DECISIONS.md` D5.

## Acceptance criteria

- B1. On a fresh run there is no obstacle while `state.distance < spawn.grace`, and by the time `state.distance >= spawn.grace + spawn.gapMax` at least one obstacle has spawned (assert with `NO_INTENT` steps, before any collision).
- B2. Every obstacle is born at `x === TUNING.width` and standing on the ground (`y + h === TUNING.groundY`, `hMin <= h <= hMax`), and on each following tick its `x` decreased by exactly `state.speed`.
- B3. An obstacle is removed on the first tick where `x + w < 0`; at no tick does `state.obstacles` contain an item with `x + w < 0`.
- B4. Determinism: two runs from the same seed, stepped with the same intents, have identical `obstacles` arrays at every tick (deepEqual of the states); two runs from different seeds differ in the `h` or the spawn tick of some obstacle within 3000 ticks.
- B5. Collision ends the run: stepping a fresh run with `NO_INTENT` (never jumping) reaches `state.over === true` within 3000 ticks, and after that 50 more `NO_INTENT` steps change neither `tick`, `distance` nor `obstacles`.
- B6. Jumping works against the obstacles: with the policy "jump when the nearest obstacle ahead is within 60 px" (the one in `scripts/play.mjs`), a run from seed 7 clears at least 3 obstacles (3 obstacles have been removed off-screen while `over` is still false).
- B7. Restart: on a run that is over, `step(state, { jump: false, duck: false, restart: true })` yields `over === false`, `tick === 0`, `distance === 0`, `obstacles.length === 0`, the dino on the ground, and the SAME object identity; the same intent on a run that is not over changes nothing (deepEqual before/after).
- B8. `npm run play -- --ticks 600 --every 60 --seed 7` prints frames containing `#` and the JSON summary; the summary's `obstaclesOnScreenMax` is `>= 1`.
- B9. The gates are green on the integrated tree: `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build`.

## Out of scope

Score and speed ramp (t3), ducking and flying obstacles, obstacle sprites, several cacti in one cluster, sound.

## References

`docs/TICKETS.md` (t2 and "The rules"), `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DECISIONS.md` (D2 randomness is state, D5), `src/game.js`, `src/rng.js`, `src/tuning.js`, `src/render.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/play.mjs`, `tests/`.
